children.value: > Fact From Story: In a sudden late announcement, OpenAI revealed that it and Altman “have reached an agreement in principle” for him to return as the company’s CEO.

> > Fact From Story: In addition to Altman’s return, its new “initial” board will include former Salesforce chief executive Bret Taylor, former US Secretary of the Treasury Larry Summers and Quora founder Adam D’Angelo.
> > > Fact From Story: Altman also posted about the new deal, giving some insight into the roller coaster that we’ve all been riding since his firing was revealed Friday.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: CEOs often communicate with the public to share insights and updates about company changes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO cannot return to a company without the agreement and support of a board or governing body.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A CEO returning to a company implies a new board is in place to oversee the company's operations.
